pyrel_code:
connection, target = Person.ref(), Person.ref()
hops = Integer.ref()
minimum_hops = Integer.ref()
strength = Float.ref()
raw_strength = Float.ref()
path = String.ref()
reason = String.ref()
distance = graph.distance(from_=center)
query = model.where(
    distance(target, connection, minimum_hops),
    Sources(connection),
    best_route(connection, hops, strength, raw_strength, path, reason),
    minimum_hops <= 2,
    hops <= 2,
    strength >= 0.1
).select(
    connection.id.alias("connection_id"), connection.name.alias("connection"),
    target.id.alias("target_id"), target.name.alias("target"),
    strength.alias("strength"), raw_strength.alias("raw_strength"), reason.alias("reason"),
    hops.alias("hops"), minimum_hops.alias("minimum_hops"), path.alias("path")
)

result.algorithm: native RAI Graph.distance + PyRel employment and strongest-route rules
result.direct_connections_definition: Starting people in this result with a direct modeled edge, even if a stronger two-hop witness was selected
result.formula: Normalized strength = sqrt(sqrt(raw_strength)); raw_strength = 0.50 × min(effective_years / mean_career_years, 1) + 0.50 × min(effective_years / 10, 1)²; effective_years = unioned shared days × location × original recency bands / 365.25; friendship deferred
result.friendship_policy: Deferred; preserved facts do not affect scores or create edges

metadata.betweenness_method: Native RAI exact UNWEIGHTED betweenness on the score-thresholded cohort topology
metadata.community_method: Native RAI weighted Louvain, seed 42, max_levels 5

independent_validation.note: Louvain partitions can vary; verify coverage and weighted modularity, not identical labels

metadata.scope: Leadership cohort: all 100 PE employees, 1000 current CEOs, 1000 synthetic Heads of Data
metadata.weight_scale: Native analytics use unchanged raw weights; displayed edge strengths use fourth-root normalization

network_context.missing_people_mean: Outside the defined cohort, not zero centrality

result.ranking: Strongest product across paths up to two hops, then fewest hops; one deterministic witness per source
result.route_formula: One hop = normalized edge strength; two hops = product of normalized leg strengths = fourth root of raw route product
